verdict.label: benign
verdict.description: Postinstall script validates native binary compatibility and installs fallback wasm if needed.

behaviors.behavior: Reads package.json to check for @swc/wasm dependency
behaviors.analysis: Line 69 reads package.json to check if @swc/wasm is already installed. This is a legitimate dependency check for native binary compatibility.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate validation step that ensures fallback wasm installation works correctly.

behaviors.behavior: Executes npm install with --no-save and --prefer-offline flags
behaviors.technique: Inspect postinstall.js line 125: child_process.execSync(`npm install --no-save --loglevel=error --prefer-offline --no-audit --progress=false @swc/wasm@${version}`, { cwd: installDir, stdio: "pipe", env });
behaviors.analysis: Line 125 executes npm install with explicit flags to avoid optional dependencies and audit warnings. This is a legitimate system-wide installation command.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate system dependency resolution that ensures fallback wasm works correctly.

behaviors.behavior: Removes installed @swc/wasm directory if it exists
behaviors.analysis: Line 134 removes the installed @swc/wasm directory if it exists. This is a legitimate cleanup step to ensure clean installation.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate cleanup step that ensures clean installation.

remediation: Review postinstall.js for any additional security checks or logic that may be misaligned with the installed binary.
Ensure SWC_BINARY_PATH environment variable is properly configured if manual override is required.
Verify native binding target triple exists in binding.js to confirm compatibility.
